title: Reagent Addition Protocol for Up to 96 Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware files (JSON extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file (Python extension, .py).

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the OT deck according to the provided deck map for the 96‑well plate layout.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the OT App to start the reagent‑addition protocol for up to 96 samples in a 96‑flat well plate.
